title: The Q-index of K_{t,s+1}-free graphs
scope: For all naturals s, t with 2 <= t and t-1 <= s there is N depending only on s and t such that for every n >= N and every simple graph G on Fin n that is K_{t,s+1}-free in the ordinary non-induced sense, the largest element of the real spectrum of A + D is at most the printed bound n/2 + s + t - 2 + (1/2) sqrt((n-2+2s)^2 - 8s(n-2) + 4(t-1)(n-t+1)), and among such G equality holds exactly when G is isomorphic to the join of K_{t-1} and an s-regular graph on n-t+1 vertices. The equality clause is inside the freeness hypothesis, as in the source.
source_targets: de Freitas, Nikiforov, Patuzzi, arXiv 1507.00625v1, Conjecture 4
validation: Nine modules compiled and kernel-checked from an empty build by an independent reviewer who read every module. A transitive closure of 35,041 constants has only the three permitted axioms and no unsafe or partial constant. Statement fidelity PASS against the source and the literal, with the scope of the equality clause analysed: the unrestricted reading is false, with a witness proved in Lean at n = 8. Lean controls prove q(K3) = 4 equal to the printed bound at (3,1,2) and the join form of the triangle, that K4 is not C4-free so that Free is not induced containment, that a free graph is accepted, that four altered formulas differ from the printed bound, and q(P3) = 3; a false claim and a sorry were rejected. Root verified receipts, hashes and the mathlib pin, read the statement and the fidelity record, and read and hand-checked the paper as listed in the QA record.
substantive_reason: Settles for every t >= 2 a deliberate printed conjecture left open for every t >= 3 since 2015, with the exact maximum and the exact equality characterization. The source proves only t = 2, states that it cannot prove or disprove the conjecture for all s and t, and says its methods seem inadequate and that completely new general techniques are needed. The structural step is not an adaptation of the source Theorem 8: it replaces the Merris bound, which stalls at error n^(1-1/t), by a hub count and eigenvector concentration with an integer gap at n+2t-4, and the hypothesis s >= t-1 is explained exactly by Lemma 0. No complete reduction to a printed result was found by either qualification or the audit.
contrary_scope_assessment: Significance is recorded as modest, and both qualifications and the auditor said an exclusion on significance would be defensible. The join lemma is a routine adaptation of source Proposition 6. The structural argument is about a page of counting, concentration and rounding with no new invariant, and heavy-vertex templates of this kind are known for adjacency and minors. Root accepted because no complete bridge exists, the source named the problem as beyond its methods, and the result was carried through a literal kernel-checked Lean proof. The user may overrule.
novelty_standard: Qualified bounded source-primary investigation, not worldwide priority certification.
prior_limits: No citation index. A UFRGS thesis, Indices de grafos livres de K_{s,t}, lume.ufrgs.br/handle/10183/180762, could not be retrieved after a connection reset and is known by title only; if it proves Conjecture 4 this acceptance must be withdrawn. The LAA 496 final version of the source, the body of Yu, Wang and Guo, ELA 30 (2015) 795-811, and RAIRO Operations Research 10.1051/ro/2023109 (HTTP 403, title never seen) are unread. The 2026 papers arXiv 2606.30272 and 2609.21367 were read and do not prove or imply the conjecture. An SBMAC proceedings item surfaced by the audit was read by root and is unrelated. Registry roots closed.

Reviewers are AI systems, not human referees, and the reviewers, auditor and Lean author share a model family; the audit read the proof and the earlier reviews first, so it is verification and not independent invention. The two written proofs share one mechanism. Conjecture 4 was compared by the audit through the text layer; one qualification viewed the glyphs of the page.
